name: What interior renovation projects offer the best return on investment?

mainEntity.name: What interior renovation projects offer the best return on investment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kitchen and bathroom remodels consistently offer high returns on investment (ROI) for homeowners. These spaces are frequently used and updated designs, fixtures, and finishes significantly enhance a home's appeal and functionality. Other projects like adding a deck or improving curb appeal can also provide good value. However, the exact ROI can vary based on local market conditions, the quality of materials, and the scope of the renovation. Focus on improvements that address current trends and common buyer preferences in your area.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen and bathroom remodels generally offer the best return on investment due to their impact on home appeal and functionality.
